title: Plasma Orb Artifact
description: A glowing plasma orb device sits on a wooden table, featuring a transparent spherical glass chamber with bright yellow, purple, and white energy tendrils radiating from a molten red-orange core. The dark metallic base displays the text "881566eb" and "35/35", with small glowing particles and lavender sprigs scattered around it against a dark, surreal landscape background.
